command: env -u PYTHONPATH PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 MPLBACKEND=Agg python -u run_planner.py
pip_check: No broken requirements found in isolated environment
notes: No repository source or configuration changes.
run.log and run_metrics.json are from direct entry-point run.
states.csv, PNG figures and summary.json are from supplemental in-memory instrumentation of same entry point, with unchanged planning configuration and logic.
summary.json cycle timings describe the supplemental run, not the direct run.
Captured state CSVs were byte-identical between normal-shell and isolated-environment supplemental runs.
Original plotting code labels acceleration plot horizontal axis as seconds but supplies integer timestep indexes; multiply by 0.1 for seconds.
output/ is git-ignored. These artifacts have not been submitted to GitHub.
